UFO's Cheat Mods Bundle [1.4.8]
A separate War Sails compatibility edition for Bannerlord v1.4.8 and War Sails v1.2.8. This is a Codex-led compatibility and maintenance build of UFOdestiny's original bundle.
IMPORTANT Do not enable this alongside UFO's Cheat Mods Bundle [1.4.7] or the No War Sails edition. Use only one UFO edition at a time. Existing saves may display a module mismatch because this edition has a new module identity.
TESTING The project compiles against Bannerlord v1.4.8 and War Sails v1.2.8, and its Harmony patches and reflected game members have been compatibility-audited. Campaign gameplay has not been exhaustively retested. Please report bugs or crashes in the comments with the action you performed, the enabled setting, and a crash ID or report link when available.
CREDITS All original work and bundle credit belongs to UFOdestiny and the original mod authors. This item is only a compatibility update.
